items.text: Farid barcuma isaa fi ganfaa isaa fudhatee dhufee siree koo irratti ol ciise – siree Bahman waggoota lamaan jalqabaa yunivarsiitii irra ciisaa ture san; halkan sana waggaa sadii dhiyaatu ture kan ho'a dhagna Bahman tasa siree irraa dagatame.
items.q: Farid brings his pillow and blanket. Are 'barcuma' and 'ganfaa' the right words?

items.text: Mandaraatti nan deeme. Dashoriin mandara keessa jira.
items.q: A child walks to the yard toilet. Are 'mandara' (yard) and 'Dashoriin' (toilet) clear?

items.text: – Yaa nama kiyya, akka kanaatti isaaf hin ariitin, mataatti ol baʼa.
items.q: Does 'hin ariitin' mean don't talk to him so politely?

items.text: Ergasii kitaabichi banamuun ija ishee bantee, gara fuula banamee ilaalte.
items.q: Is it clear that she opens the book herself, on purpose?

items.text: – Hojiin isaa hundi gochawwan ajjeesan ture, namticha sana.
items.q: Is it clear that everything he did was suicidal, a danger to himself?

items.text: Yeroo hunda sodaa kana qaba ture, yoo Taghi guyyaa tokko fedhii qabaate Yaser mataa isaa naanneessuuf, yoos ani Hamid mataa koo irra naanneessuu qaba ture.
items.q: Is it clear that Hamid would swing the narrator above his own head?

items.text: Foolii daabboo garuu fedhii koo caalaa jabaata ture.
items.q: The classrooms are being painted. Is 'daabboo' the right word for paint?

items.text: Waadaan gala, xiqqoo isarratti hojjenna, fuula keessan duratti of duuba deebi'ee "fudhadhaa" jedha.
items.q: Is it clear he would pull down his own trousers in front of you?
